<!-- theorem-1: body_md -->
\label{inf_Stoker}
    Let $P\subset\mathbb{R}^d,d\ge 2$ be a convex polytope with facets $F_i$, outward unit normal vectors $n_i$ and dihedral angles $\theta_{ij}$.
    Given an infinitesimal deformation of $P$ with $\dot\theta_{ij}\ge 0$ when\-ever $F_i$ and $F_j$ are adjacent, then there exists a skew-symmetric matrix $S\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$ with $\dot n_i = S n_i$ for all $i$.
<!-- end theorem-1 -->
